reason: Re-measured at 18:30:31Z (21:30 MSK). Win32_Battery shows 64%, BatteryStatus 1 (discharging), EstimatedRunTime 136 min. root/wmi BatteryStatus shows PowerOnline False, 35.3 Wh left, 15.5 W draw. Over 15.5 min (69% at 18:14:58Z to 64%) the laptop drained 5 points, about 19-20%/h. The finding's 28%/h came from a noisy 4-minute window, but its conclusion holds. powercfg (Balanced) on battery: idle sleep never, critical level 2%, critical action Hibernate. By energy use and the WMI runtime estimate, hibernation comes at ~20:45Z. Extrapolating the observed percent drop gives ~21:40Z. So the window is roughly 23:45 MSK to 00:40 MSK: after the 23:00 MSK tick, a coin flip for the 00:05 MSK (21:05Z) last SELECTED check, and certain to miss the 03:07 MSK (00:07Z) post-deadline save, stop and commit. The events before 20:00Z (18:37Z card, T7 19:12-19:20Z, 19:43Z check, manual-admit 19:44:45Z) are safe. The pair П3 is already ticked on the server, so the finals are not affected. Watchdog 16220 is alive but only alerts on AC return or a stale poll, never on battery percent. The action is only a chat message plus an optional local alert. It makes 0 Kaggle calls, fails soft, does not touch R1-R10 or decision B, and kills or restarts nothing. The only fix is to refresh the numbers in the message.
fix: Send the chat line with current numbers (MSK first): 'Ноутбук на батарее: 64 % в 21:30 МСК (18:30Z), расход ~20 %/ч, гибернация при 2 % — примерно 23:45 МСК – 00:40 МСК. Подключите зарядку до 23:00 МСК и не закрывайте крышку; иначе проверка отметки в 00:05 МСК может не пройти, а сохранение ЛБ в 03:07 МСК точно не выполнится (на уже отмеченную пару П3 это не влияет). Чтение exp89t жду в 21:25–21:45 МСК — строка придёт сюда, в чат.' Optionally arm a local one-shot background check, with 0 Kaggle calls, that prints once when EstimatedChargeRemaining <= 25 (expected ~20:25Z) or when PowerOnline turns True. Do not kill or restart jobs. Do not change the power plan without the user's OK.
realistic_gain: No score gain. This is operational insurance. It keeps the 00:05 MSK last-call SELECTED check (the only guard against an accidental re-tick) and the 03:07 MSK final-LB save and commit from being lost to a hibernate. The cost is one chat line.
